proof_body:
by
  intro z h
  have h1 := h.hasDerivAt.complexToReal_fderiv
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (starRingEnd ℂ) w) (Complex.conjCLE : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) z :=
    Complex.conjCLE.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 := h1.unique h2
  have a := congrArg (fun L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ => L 1) h3
  have b := congrArg (fun L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ => L Complex.I) h3
  simp at a b
  rw [a] at b
  have c := congrArg Complex.im b
  norm_num at c
target_source: ∀ (z : ℂ), ¬ DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => (starRingEnd ℂ) w) z
